name: roles-autorole
description: Multi-role autorole on join with filters, optional delay, and a durable pending queue

configFields.label: Autorole Enabled
configFields.description: Assign configured roles when members join

configFields.label: Assignment Delay
configFields.description: Seconds to wait before assigning roles. 0 assigns immediately.

configFields.label: Minimum Account Age
configFields.description: Accounts younger than this are skipped. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Required Roles
configFields.description: Member must already have at least one of these roles

configFields.label: Ignored Roles
configFields.description: Members with any of these roles are skipped

configFields.label: Only On Join
configFields.description: Only apply from the join listener, not manual runs
